Module Contents¶

src.core.data_preprocessing.preprocess_data(df: pandas.DataFrame) → pandas.DataFrame¶

Preprocess a dataframe to clean the data. It has been designed to preprocess the SNCF dataset.

Transformations :

  1. Invalidate the data from the Covid period

2. Invalidate the data from the columns “Nombre trains en retard > 30min” and “Nombre trains en retard > 60min” in Q1 2025

  1. If no train is delayed at arrival, replacing 0 values of average delay by NaN

  2. If no train is delayed at departure, invalidating values of average delay by NaN

5. Imputing historical median if trains are delayed but the average delay “Retard moyen des trains en retard à l’arrivée” is less than or equal to 0. The median is calculated for the same service, route and month, with at least 2 valid observations.

6. Adding a column “Prct retard causes non renseignées” and calculating the percentage to have a sum of 100% for all the reasons of delay

7. Invalidating values from “Nombre trains en retard > 15min” when they exceed the overall number of trains delayed at arrival.

8. Replacing negative average delays for all trains by 0 when they are between -1 (included) and 0 (excluded), and by NaN when they are below -1.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – dataframe from the original SNCF dataset with these expected

  • least (columns at) – “Date”, “Service”, “Gare de départ”, “Gare d’arrivée”, “Nombre de trains en retard à l’arrivée”, “Nombre de trains en retard au départ”, “Nombre trains en retard > 30min”, “Nombre trains en retard > 60min”, “Retard moyen des trains en retard à l’arrivée”, “Retard moyen des trains en retard au départ”, “Prct retard pour causes externes”, “Prct retard pour cause infrastructure”, “Prct retard pour cause gestion trafic”, “Prct retard pour cause matériel roulant”, “Prct retard pour cause gestion en gare et réutilisation de matériel”, “Prct retard pour cause prise en compte voyageurs (affluence, gestions PSH, correspondances)”, “Nombre trains en retard > 15min”, “Retard moyen de tous les trains à l’arrivée”, “Retard moyen de tous les trains au départ”,

Returns:

a dataframe with the applied transformations

Return type:

pd.DataFrame
